notes: All nine campaign websites recorded here were already in the record as filed with the Secretary of State; each was opened and names the candidate and the office. Laura Knudsen's filed site answered 429 twice and was not asked again, so it is not repeated here.
The Minnesota Judicial Branch site answered 403; it was not asked again or worked around, so the two judges (Bridget Ann Sullivan, Jennifer D. Peterson) have no findings.
María Isa Pérez-Vega: the Ramsey County race is nonpartisan and reports say the DFL convention for the seat ended with no endorsement, so none is recorded.

Jay Lawton: West Central Tribune (August 17, 2022, carried at https://news.yahoo.com/five-candidates-running-three-seats-063500056.html) says he was elected in 2018; the district's own page gives only the end of the term, so no start year is recorded.

Jeffrey Dahl (Otsego): the search results were about a different Jeffrey Dahl (a city administrator elsewhere) and the city's council page does not list him; nothing recorded. No findings either for Nathan Ryan, Emma Richtman, Lisa Loidolt, Scott Milliman or Philip Norgaard.
A few campaign pages print a committee mailing address in their disclaimer; none of that was kept.

Verifier: every url was re-opened on 2026-10-02. dfl.org and two campaign sites would not resolve through the search reader (the router dropping lookups) and were read with the kit's own fetcher instead. The DFL list gives each candidate under their district, which is the second anchor.
